title: MADO Cockpit Approval Console
audience: Operators reviewing AI-generated asset and UI changes
goal: Build a restrained, responsive approval screen that makes source provenance, change details, and human authorization understandable without changing backend permissions.
theme: Respect existing MADO tokens, dark and light themes, no brand replacement
acceptance: Show a proposed component change with clear source and license state.
Expose a human approval action whose enabled state reflects an explicit validated permission.
Show a readable diff summary and evidence links, with keyboard focus.
Retain sensible responsive layout and reduced-motion alternatives.
Do not auto-approve or perform real write actions in this isolated benchmark.
